title: Output on the all-true initial state
statement: For every finite binary word $l$, consider the one-pass transducer that updates its Boolean state by replacing $q$ with $q\lor\neg b$ on input bit $b$, and emits $0$ when the current state is true and emits nothing otherwise. Started in state true, this transducer outputs the word consisting of $|l|$ zeroes.
